notes: Modified cash basis city. Trimmed PDF has 20 pages (63 in original): p1 Statement of Net Position, pp2-4 Statement of Activities, pp5-6 governmental funds balance sheet, pp7-8 revenues, pp9-10 expenditures/changes in fund balances, pp11-12 proprietary Statement of Net Position, pp13-14 proprietary revenues/expenses, pp15-16 proprietary cash flows, pp17-18 total primary government budgetary comparison, pp19-20 Schedule of Expenditures by fund and object. Governmental amounts use the Total column. Governmental identity: 572,634 + 673,960 - 608,480 + 170,500 + 35,154 = 843,768. Ending_cash is the fund balance rolled forward (843,768); cash in bank/treasurer is 851,268 with 7,500 due to other funds. Business-type: proprietary funds Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (pp13-14, Totals column; accrual, so measure = net position). The 170,500 transfers to governmental funds are printed as proprietary Transfers (Electric 149,000, Water 21,500; p14). Business roll: 2,736,965 + 1,345,265 - 1,180,949 - 170,500 = 2,730,781. Proprietary field left null as the report is cash basis. Statement of Net Position p1 (total net position 5,712,685; governmental 2,981,904 includes capital assets 1,803,293) prints net position only, with no asset/liability lines, so it cannot serve as a balance sheet; balance_sheet combines the governmental funds balance sheet Total column (p6) with the proprietary funds Statement of Net Position Totals column (pp11-12), each line tagged with fund_type; totals are the sums of the two printed totals (computed). The 7,500 due to/from other funds is kept as printed. Detail (attempt 2, verifier fix): governmental expenditures come from the Schedule of Expenditures - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (pp19-20), fund by fund and object by object (zero lines and the all-zero Keno Fund column skipped), replacing the statement's function totals; its fund totals tie to the statement columns (p9-10). Function per fund follows the statement: General Fund lines are general government except its Public Safety line (63,900 on the schedule vs 63,729 on the statement, 171 shifted into General Government on the statement); Community Center = general government, Medical Center = health/welfare, Airport = other (no airport category). Governmental revenue and other-financing lines and the proprietary lines remain per-fund lines from the fund statements (p7-10, p13-14), kept from attempt 1. The budget schedule (pp17-18) mixes funds and duplicates the statements, so it is not recorded. Farm Income (Airport Fund) is categorised Rentals (farm lease) in both receipts and detail.
